transfer_rules.nationality_condition: Domestic (Chinese resident) individuals for FX purchase; all individuals for FX settlement
transfer_rules.rule_name: Annual individual FX convenience quota (USD 50,000 per person per year)
transfer_rules.rule_summary: Each person can buy foreign currency (Chinese residents) and convert foreign currency into RMB (all individuals) up to USD 50,000 equivalent per year each, using only a valid ID. This is a convenience quota, not a hard cap: larger current-account amounts are allowed with proof of the real transaction.
documents_required: Proof of the underlying transaction with amount (above quota)
transfer_rules.restrictions: Quota is per person per year; unused quota cannot be carried over to the next year (per Bank of China's description of the rule).
transfer_rules.exceptions: Purchases/settlements backed by documents showing a genuine current-account transaction can be made without using the quota.
transfer_rules.evidence_quote: 年度总额分别为每人每年等值5万美元。

transfer_rules.rule_name: USD 50,000 is a convenience quota, not an annual limit
transfer_rules.rule_summary: SAFE explains that the USD 50,000 figure is the amount you can transact with just your ID each year, not the maximum you may ever buy or convert. Genuine needs above it are handled with supporting documents.
transfer_rules.evidence_quote: 等值 5 万美元是年度便利化额度，不是个人每年结汇、购汇的限额。

transfer_rules.rule_name: Buying FX for overseas study: use the quota or buy outside it with school documents
transfer_rules.rule_summary: A student (or payer) can choose whether study-abroad FX purchases use their USD 50,000 annual quota. Using the quota needs only ID; buying without using the quota (e.g. tuition above USD 50,000) needs ID plus school documents such as the admission notice or the overseas school's tuition payment notice.
documents_required: Admission notice from overseas school (入学通知书) when not using quota
Overseas school tuition payment notice (学费缴费通知) when not using quota
transfer_rules.evidence_quote: 个人可以自主选择是否占用本人便利化额度。

transfer_rules.rule_name: Tuition above USD 50,000: purchase outside the quota with school fee notice
transfer_rules.rule_summary: If tuition exceeds USD 50,000, you can buy the FX without using your annual quota by showing your ID and the overseas school's tuition fee notice.
transfer_rules.evidence_quote: 可凭本人有效身份证件、境外学校学费缴费通知等材料办理不占用年度便利化额度的购汇。

transfer_rules.visa_condition: Valid visa (or endorsement) for the study destination
transfer_rules.rule_name: Bank document checklist for self-funded study abroad above the quota
transfer_rules.rule_summary: Bank of China asks for your passport with a valid visa, the overseas school's admission letter, and a tuition or living-cost certificate for the academic year or term when buying study-abroad FX above the annual quota. The admission letter is not needed for second-year or later payments.
documents_required: Personal passport with valid visa (or endorsement)
Admission letter from overseas school (not needed for 2nd academic year/term onward)
Tuition fees or living costs certificate for the academic year or term
transfer_rules.exceptions: Admission letter waived when paying for a second academic year or term.
transfer_rules.evidence_quote: Personal private passport and valid visa (or endorsement);

transfer_rules.rule_name: Prohibited uses of the personal FX purchase quota
transfer_rules.rule_summary: FX bought under the personal quota cannot be used for overseas property, securities investment, life insurance or investment-type dividend insurance, or other capital-account items not yet opened. You also cannot lend your quota to others, borrow others' quota to split purchases, make false declarations, or use it for money laundering, gambling, tax evasion or underground banking.
documents_required: Signed Personal FX Purchase Application (个人购汇申请书) declaring purpose
transfer_rules.restrictions: No overseas home purchases, securities investment, life/investment-linked insurance; no lending/borrowing quota; no false information or documents; no illegal activities.
transfer_rules.evidence_quote: 不得用于境外买房、证券投资、购买人寿保险和投资性返还分红类保险等尚未开放的资本项目；

transfer_rules.rule_name: Declare the purchase purpose; overseas study is a listed purpose
transfer_rules.rule_summary: Every personal FX purchase requires declaring its purpose on the application form. 'Overseas study' (境外留学) is one of the listed current-account purposes, alongside travel, medical treatment and others.
documents_required: Personal FX Purchase Application with declared purpose
transfer_rules.evidence_quote: 境外留学

transfer_rules.rule_name: No splitting transactions; violators go on the SAFE watch list
transfer_rules.rule_summary: You must not split purchases (e.g. using family or friends' quotas) to get around the quota or authenticity checks. Violators are placed on SAFE's 'watch list' for the year listed plus the next two years and lose quota convenience; records may also enter the personal credit file.
transfer_rules.restrictions: Watch-list period: year of listing plus 2 following years; quota convenience lost during that period.
transfer_rules.evidence_quote: 个人不得以分拆等方式规避便利化额度及真实性管理。

transfer_rules.rule_name: Outward remittance from a personal FX savings account: ID only up to USD 50,000/day
transfer_rules.rule_summary: Residents can remit from their own FX savings account abroad for current-account purposes with just ID if the day's total is USD 50,000 equivalent or less; above that, proof of the transaction is needed. Remitting foreign cash on hand is ID-only up to USD 10,000 per day.
documents_required: Proof of current-account transaction amount (above USD 50,000/day)
transfer_rules.restrictions: Cash-on-hand remittance: ID-only up to USD 10,000 equivalent per day.
transfer_rules.evidence_quote: accumulatively reach an equivalent value of below USD 50,000 (inclusive) on that very day

transfer_rules.rule_name: Domestic transfers from personal FX accounts limited to own and close-relative accounts
transfer_rules.rule_summary: Foreign currency in a personal FX account can only be moved within China between your own accounts or between you and close relatives (e.g. a parent to a student child). Purchased FX may be remitted abroad, deposited into your own FX savings account, or carried out within the rules.
documents_required: Relatives' valid ID/proof of relationship when transferring to close relatives
transfer_rules.restrictions: Only own accounts and close relatives' accounts.
transfer_rules.evidence_quote: 仅限于本人账户之间、个人与近亲属账户之间。

transfer_rules.rule_name: Receiving FX from abroad: no limit on receipt; conversion uses quota or documents
transfer_rules.rule_summary: Residents can receive genuine current-account FX remittances from abroad with no amount or frequency limit. Converting the FX to RMB uses the USD 50,000 annual settlement quota with ID, or can be done outside the quota with documents showing the source of funds.
transfer_rules.evidence_quote: 境内个人接受境外外汇汇款，不存在限额或次数限制的概念。

transfer_rules.nationality_condition: Foreign individual (境外个人) without Foreign Permanent Resident ID Card
transfer_rules.rule_name: Foreigners have no USD 50,000 FX purchase quota (except permanent residents)
transfer_rules.rule_summary: Foreign nationals in China (including international students) do not get the annual USD 50,000 FX purchase quota; they buy FX with ID plus documents showing the source of the RMB (including tax records), e.g. for salary. They do have a USD 50,000 annual settlement quota for converting FX into RMB. Holders of China's Foreign Permanent Resident ID Card are exempt.
documents_required: Source-of-funds documents with amount, including tax certificates
transfer_rules.restrictions: Single FX-to-RMB settlement above USD 50,000 equivalent: RMB must go directly to the counterparty's domestic RMB account.
transfer_rules.exceptions: Holders of the PRC Foreign Permanent Resident ID Card receive the purchase quota.
transfer_rules.evidence_quote: 境外个人不享有每年等值 5 万美元的购汇便利化额度

transfer_rules.rule_name: Foreigners can remit out of their FX savings account with ID only
transfer_rules.rule_summary: Funds already in a foreigner's FX savings account can be sent abroad with no amount or purpose limit, using only a valid ID. Remitting foreign cash on hand is ID-only up to USD 10,000 per day; above that a customs declaration or the original withdrawal slip is needed.
documents_required: Customs declaration or original withdrawal slip (cash above USD 10,000/day)
transfer_rules.evidence_quote: 境外个人外汇储蓄账户资金汇出无金额和用途限制，凭本人有效身份证件直接在银行办理。

transfer_rules.rule_name: Foreigners buying FX with legal RMB income (e.g. salary)
transfer_rules.rule_summary: Foreigners can convert legal RMB current-account income earned in China (such as salary) into FX with ID and documents showing the amount, including tax certificates.
transfer_rules.evidence_quote: 在境内取得的经常项目合法人民币收入，凭本人有效身份证件和有交易额的相关证明材料（含税务凭证）办理购汇。

transfer_rules.rule_name: Converting unused RMB back to FX (within 24 months)
transfer_rules.rule_summary: Foreigners can change unused RMB back into foreign currency with their ID and the original exchange receipt; the receipt is valid for 24 months from the exchange date.
transfer_rules.restrictions: Exchange memo valid for 24 months from the exchange date.
transfer_rules.evidence_quote: 原兑换未用完的人民币兑回外汇，凭本人有效身份证件和原兑换水单办理

transfer_rules.rule_name: International students converting FX above the quota for school fees
transfer_rules.rule_summary: A foreigner converting FX into RMB above the USD 50,000 annual settlement quota for study expenses in China must show their ID plus the Chinese school's fee certificate.
documents_required: Fee certificate from the school in China (学校收费证明)
transfer_rules.evidence_quote: 就医、学习等支出：境内医院（学校）收费证明；

transfer_rules.rule_name: Withdrawing foreign cash above USD 10,000/day requires prior SAFE report
transfer_rules.rule_summary: Individuals can withdraw foreign-currency cash directly at a bank up to USD 10,000 equivalent per day; above that, they must report to the local SAFE branch in advance.
transfer_rules.restrictions: Depositing foreign cash into an FX savings account is direct up to USD 5,000 equivalent per day.
transfer_rules.evidence_quote: 个人提取外币现钞当日累计等值1万美元以下（含）的，可以在银行直接办理

transfer_rules.rule_name: Carrying foreign-currency cash out of China
transfer_rules.rule_summary: You can take up to USD 5,000 equivalent in foreign cash out without a permit. Between USD 5,000 and 10,000 you need a Permit for Carrying Foreign Currency Outbound from a bank; above USD 10,000 the permit must come from SAFE and is granted only in special cases. Permits are single-use and valid 30 days.
documents_required: Permit for Carrying Foreign Currency Outbound (携带证) above USD 5,000
transfer_rules.restrictions: In principle, no more than USD 10,000 equivalent may be carried out except in special circumstances approved by SAFE.
transfer_rules.exceptions: Amounts covered by the most recent entry declaration of foreign cash.
transfer_rules.regulator: State Administration of Foreign Exchange; General Administration of Customs
transfer_rules.evidence_quote: 出境人员携出金额在等值5000美元以内(含5000美元)的，不需申领《携带证》，海关予以放行。

transfer_rules.rule_name: Declare foreign cash above USD 5,000 when entering China
transfer_rules.rule_summary: Travellers bringing in more than USD 5,000 equivalent in foreign cash must declare it in writing to customs.
transfer_rules.exceptions: Same-day multiple round trips and frequent short-term round trips.
transfer_rules.regulator: General Administration of Customs; State Administration of Foreign Exchange
transfer_rules.evidence_quote: 入境人员携带外币现钞入境，超过等值5000美元的应当向海关书面申报

transfer_rules.rule_name: RMB cash carried in or out limited to RMB 20,000 per trip
transfer_rules.rule_summary: Each traveller may carry up to RMB 20,000 in cash into or out of China per trip.
transfer_rules.evidence_quote: each visitor is allowed to take up to RMB20,000 in cash in or out of the country each time

transfer_rules.rule_name: Banks report large cross-border transfers by individuals
transfer_rules.rule_summary: Banks must file a large-value transaction report when an individual's account sends or receives cross-border transfers of RMB 200,000 or USD 10,000 equivalent or more in a day (single or cumulative). Cash transactions of RMB 50,000 / USD 10,000 or more are also reported. This is automatic bank reporting, not a ban.
transfer_rules.restrictions: Cash threshold: RMB 50,000 or USD 10,000 equivalent per day.
transfer_rules.evidence_quote: 人民币20万元以上（含20万元）、外币等值1万美元以上（含1万美元）的跨境款项划转

transfer_rules.nationality_condition: Overseas visitors using mobile payment platforms
transfer_rules.rule_name: Mobile payment limits for overseas users (USD 5,000 per transaction, USD 50,000 per year)
transfer_rules.rule_summary: Overseas visitors using mobile payment platforms (e.g. linked foreign cards) can pay up to USD 5,000 per transaction and USD 50,000 per year cumulatively (raised in 2024).
transfer_rules.evidence_quote: The annual cumulative transaction cap has been increased from 10,000 dollars to 50,000 dollars.

account_opening.summary: Foreign nationals, including international students, can open a personal RMB debit/settlement account at Chinese banks in person at a branch counter. The core document is a valid passport (or Foreign Permanent Resident ID Card). Banks verify identity, willingness to open the account and its purpose; a real-name mainland China mobile number is required or recommended, and proof of local address may be requested. Shanghai's official guide lists the long-term study visa among visa types accepted for opening a debit card account, and a signed Declaration of Personal Tax Residency Status is required. Minimum opening deposits are nominal (e.g. RMB 1 at ICBC and Bank of China). Exact requirements vary by bank and branch.
typical_documents: Valid passport (or Foreign Permanent Resident ID Card)
Valid visa/residence permit of an accepted type (e.g. long-term study visa, residence visa, employment visa)
Real-name registered mainland China mobile phone number
Proof of address in mainland China (recommended/bank-dependent)
Signed Declaration of Personal Tax Residency Status
Possibly work certificate or tax ID number (bank-dependent)
eligibility_factors: Valid identity document under the real-name account system
Accepted visa type (Shanghai guide lists long-term study visa as accepted)
Bank's verification of identity, willingness to open the account and stated purpose
In-person counter application during business hours
Chinese citizens may open accounts independently from age 16 (ICBC, BOC); no explicit foreigner minimum age found

banks.bank_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China
banks.account_type: Personal RMB / foreign-currency current (demand) deposit account
documents: Passport or Foreign Permanent Resident ID Card (foreign citizens)
Bank may request other valid ID or certification documents
banks.minimum_balance: Minimum deposit RMB 1.00 (RMB); foreign currency not less than RMB 20.00 equivalent
banks.evidence_quote: Foreign citizens need to show passports or alien permanent registration card.
banks.notes: Foreigner eligibility is stated generally; international-student eligibility inferred from foreigner eligibility. Age 16+ stated for Chinese citizens only. Outward remittance (telegraphic transfer, draft, MoneyGram) available for domestic and foreign customers; self-funded overseas study above threshold needs admission letter and school payment notice (https://www.icbc.com.cn/en/column/1438058479532523679.html). ICBC also offers overseas study loans and overseas account-opening witness services. Credit card eligibility for foreigners not confirmed.

banks.account_type: Current All-In-One Account / domestic debit card; Personal Foreign Exchange Savings Account
banks.minimum_balance: Initial deposit RMB 1 or equivalent of RMB 100 in foreign currency
banks.credit_card_available: Primary card age 18+ (supplementary 14+). Foreigners need passport, work-type residence permit and foreign work permit, or a Foreign Permanent Resident ID Card; ID must be valid 1+ year and 3+ months from expiry. Students on study residence permits appear not to meet the primary-card criteria.
banks.evidence_quote: Foreign customers can apply for the domestic debit card in China at any BOC outlet
banks.notes: Evidence quote from BOC inbound visitors guide (https://www.boc.cn/en/custserv/202404/t20240403_24845718.html). Credit-card rules: https://www.boc.cn/bcservice/bi2/202402/P020240207374945846200.pdf. Outward overseas remittance and study-abroad FX purchase services documented (https://www.boc.cn/en/pbservice/pb4/200806/t20080626_1323979.html); also offers FX loans for studying abroad and overseas account-opening witness services. resident_required=false based on 'No registered permanent residence restriction' for FX purchase and passport acceptance for accounts. Age 16+ stated for Chinese nationals only.

documents: Foreign passport or Foreign Permanent Resident ID Card
Proof of address in mainland China (recommended)
banks.credit_card_available: Available to foreigners meeting conditions: proof of employer's business relationship with ABC, or assets at ABC, or valid permanent residence card; plus fixed residence/stable job or business in the issuing area, ID, income/asset proof and tax documents.
banks.evidence_quote: 在覈實您的本人身份、開戶意願、開卡用途等信息後，可為您辦理開卡。
banks.notes: Source is ABC's Payment Service Guide for Inbound Visitors (2nd ed., 2024-03-28) on ABC's Hainan branch site. ABC offers outbound personal cross-border remittance and salary FX purchase-and-remit for foreign customers (first time: ID, service contract, after-tax income proof). ABC's 'College Student Card' (credit-type card, student ID or admission notice, first-year annual fee waived) exists (https://www.abchina.com/en/personal/debit-card/csc/) but eligibility of international students is not stated. student_account_available refers to that card. resident_required=false because the guide does not require a residence permit (only passport).

banks.visa_requirements: Credit card: residence permit or employment permit required for foreigners
banks.credit_card_available: Foreigners must provide passport plus residence permit or employment permit (CMB credit card site).
banks.evidence_quote: 外籍人士需要提供护照及居留证或就业证
banks.notes: Only the credit-card requirement was confirmed (https://xyk.cmbchina.com/LatteSubsite/zhishi/0033.html). CMB English and Chinese product pages (All-in-one card, overseas remittance, FX sale/purchase) are JavaScript-rendered and returned no content; direct download was blocked by the network proxy. Account-opening eligibility, documents, fees and remittance details need verification.

bureaus: Credit Reference Center of the People's Bank of China (中国人民银行征信中心)
what_contributes: Personal basic information (name, ID type and number, nationality, marital status, etc.)
Credit card accounts (贷记卡 and 准贷记卡), including overdue history
Loans reported by lenders (e.g. housing loans, car loans)
Other credit business (finance leasing; securities firms' repo, stock pledge and margin financing)
Asset disposal and advance-payment (guarantor/insurer compensation) records
Public information: tax arrears, civil judgments, enforcement and administrative penalty records
Query records for the last 2 years (by institutions and by the individual)
why_it_matters: Lenders use the report to judge your willingness and ability to repay
The credit system addresses information asymmetry in financial transactions
SAFE says FX violations (e.g. splitting purchases) can be recorded in personal credit records
responsible_behaviours: Repay loans and credit cards on time every month
Check your own report: two free reports per year (RMB 10 per extra query that year)
Dispute errors through official channels (PBOC, the Credit Reference Center or your lender)
Never pay third parties for 'credit repair'; the Center offers no such service
Do not lend your FX quota or ID to others or split transactions
risks: Negative information stays on the report for 5 years from the date the bad behaviour or event ends
Credit-repair scams: the Center does not handle overdue-record removal or 'credit repair' and does not charge the public for services
FX violations can lead to SAFE watch-list listing (listing year + 2 years) and entries in personal credit records
PBOC's one-time credit repair policy (single overdue amounts up to RMB 10,000 occurring before 2025-12-31, repaid by 2026-03-31) was automatic and free; its repayment window has now closed
credit_system.foreigner_notes: The credit report's identity section includes nationality, but no foreigner-specific rules were found on the Credit Reference Center pages fetched; contact the Center (400-810-8866) for foreigners' query eligibility. In practice, foreigners' access to credit depends on banks: e.g. Bank of China requires a work-type residence permit and work permit for primary credit cards, and CMB requires a residence or employment permit.
